stages.blocker: Candidate was selected from existing validation folders.
No independent source-aware, expert-reviewed test labels are present.
Lesion recall remains 0.45 and all metrics are validation-only.
Smoke test has no joint ground truth, so it is not an end-to-end accuracy evaluation.
TP/FP/FN error rates require expert-reviewed test annotations.
Baseline was zero-shot and not trained on the identical rebuilt split.

required_external_inputs: Independent source-aware test images and labels
Expert review of fish, lesion, and disease labels
Joint image-level ground truth for end-to-end scoring
Controlled plain-YOLO baseline trained on the same split and configuration
safe_claim: The repository is a reproducible prototype/experimental decision-support pipeline, not a validated final diagnostic system.
